October 8, 2026 (Thu) Update Details - Combat Level & EXP Revamp and More

Combat Level & EXP Revamp

  • Increased the max character level: 70 → 75
  • EXP no longer increases at Lv. 75. Tagged characters still accumulate EXP.
  • From Lv. 70, each level grants +3 Extra AP Against Monsters and +3 Monster Damage Reduction (3 / 6 / 9 / 12 / 15 / 18). These effects do not stack.
  • The EXP required to reach the next level has been changed for every level range.
  • Monster name colours now use 7 tiers instead of 11.
  • Characters gain +3 Monster Damage Reduction per level above the monster, up to 3 levels (max +9).

Combat EXP gained per monster kill is now capped (includes Combat EXP increase effects)

Lv. 1 – 5: 20%
Lv. 6 – 10: 18%
Lv. 11 – 15: 16%
Lv. 16 – 20: 14%
Lv. 21 – 25: 12%
Lv. 26 – 30: 10%
Lv. 31 – 35: 8%
Lv. 36 – 40: 6%
Lv. 41 – 47: 5%
Lv. 48 – 49: 3.5%
Lv. 50 – 55: 2%
Lv. 56 – 61: 0.2%
Lv. 62 – 64: 0.02%
Lv. 65 or higher: 0.01%

EXP Buffs

  • Body Enhancement: Combat EXP 50% → 100%
  • Adventure’s Boon: Combat EXP 15% → 30%
  • Pearl Outfit 4-part set effect: Combat EXP 10% → 50%
  • Pearl Outfit 6-part set effect: Skill EXP 10% → 50%

Combat Secret Books (Lv. 60 or higher, Family-bound; values at Lv. 66)

  • Combat Secret Book (Small): 0.2% EXP
  • Combat Secret Book (Medium): 1% EXP
  • Combat Secret Book (Large): 7.5% EXP
  • Combat Secret Book (Extra Large): 15% EXP
  • Delivered after the Oct 15 (Thu) maintenance, counted from Oct 8.

Monster Zone Info

  • Monster Zone Info now lists each zone’s monsters and the EXP each kill gives.
  • A recommended level is now shown before each zone name.
